items.definition:
an unmarried woman
She celebrated her bachelorette party with her closest friends.

an instrument measuring atmospheric pressure
The barometer showed a drop in pressure, indicating a storm.

A freshwater fish
The carp swam slowly in the pond.

The distance around a circle
We measured the circumference of the tree trunk.

The state of being calm and in control
Despite the chaos, she maintained her composure.

A rare or expensive food item; sensitivity
Caviar is considered a delicacy in many cultures.

The last day of the world; a day of judgment
Some people believe doomsday is near.

A large, bright meteor; a ball of fire
A bright fireball streaked across the night sky.

the main point or essence
Can you give me the gist of the meeting?

a connection or arrangement, often informal or temporary
He got a good hookup for concert tickets.

the process of absorbing water
Proper hydration is essential for good health.

improvisation, especially in comedy or music
They performed an amazing improv show.

the process of creating an index or list
Search engines rely on efficient indexing.

the inability to conceive children or young
They sought treatment for infertility.

a person who acts as a link between people in order to try to bring about an agreement
The diplomat acted as an intermediary in the peace talks.

a canopy projecting over an entrance; a large tent
The theater's marquee lit up the street with its bright lights.

a microorganism, especially a bacterium causing disease
Scientists study microbes to understand how they affect human health.

the birth of a person, especially Jesus Christ
The children performed a nativity play for their parents.

a state of great activity, effort, or speed
The team went into overdrive to finish the project on time.

a magazine or journal published at regular intervals
The library subscribes to many academic periodicals.

a flat, dry lake bed; (Spanish) beach
The annual festival is held on the vast desert playa.

a body of armed men, typically a sheriff's force; a group of friends
The sheriff formed a posse to track down the outlaws.

the process of cooling a space or substance to a low temperature
Modern refrigeration allows us to store food safely for longer periods.

a heavy cavalry sword with a curved blade
The cavalry officer drew his saber and charged.

the act of bombarding with shells; the removal of a shell
The constant shelling forced residents to evacuate.

a chemical element, a yellow non-metallic solid
Sulphur has a distinctive smell.

a three-legged stand, often used for cameras or telescopes
He set up his camera on a tripod.

a main road on which a toll is charged
We took the turnpike to avoid traffic.

a person whose business is preparing dead bodies for burial or cremation
The undertaker arranged the funeral service.

a large bird of prey that feeds on carrion
A vulture circled high above the desert.

a person who is absent from work or school
The teacher marked the absentee in her register.

a condition in which the blood lacks healthy red blood cells
The doctor diagnosed her with iron-deficiency anemia.

a device used to store an electric charge
The circuit board needs a new capacitor.

a person who holds moderate political views
The new party leader is known for his centrist policies.

each of the seven centers of spiritual power in the human body, according to Hinduism and Buddhism
She meditated to balance her chakras.

a person employed to drive a private or hired car
The CEO arrived with his personal chauffeur.

a male priest, minister, or religious leader
The clergyman delivered a powerful sermon.

a large amphitheater or stadium
The ancient coliseum once hosted gladiatorial contests.

a polluting or toxic substance
The water supply was found to have a dangerous contaminant.

a member of a council
The councilman voted against the new zoning proposal.

long and careful consideration or discussion
After much deliberation, they decided to accept the offer.

deceitfulness; lack of honesty
His dishonesty led to his dismissal from the company.

the group of European Union countries that use the euro as their common currency
Greece is a member of the Eurozone.

a person who has committed a felony
The former felon struggled to find employment.

the lead singer of a band or a person who represents an organization
Mick Jagger is the frontman of The Rolling Stones.

a type of dog known for its speed
The greyhound is one of the fastest dog breeds.

the quality of being hard
The hardness of the diamond makes it very durable.

a place of significant activity or danger; a place offering wireless internet access
The cafe offers a free Wi-Fi hotspot.

the presence of an unusually large number of insects or animals
They had a serious cockroach infestation in their old apartment.

the quality of being unwilling to work or use energy
His laziness prevented him from finishing the project on time.

a parasitic worm; a person who exploits others
The doctor used a leech to reduce the swelling.

a Hawaiian garland of flowers
Visitors to Hawaii are often greeted with a beautiful lei.

the sport of motor racing
He has been a fan of motorsport since he was a child.

a person who passes by or through a place
The passer stopped to admire the street art.

a public square or marketplace, especially in an Italian town
We enjoyed a coffee in the bustling piazza.

a person responsible for making policies, especially in government
Policymakers are debating new environmental regulations.

a paved public walk, typically one along a waterfront at a resort
We took a leisurely stroll along the seaside promenade.

a close and harmonious relationship in which the people or groups concerned understand each other's feelings or ideas and communicate well
Building a good rapport with clients is essential for success.

a heavy cavalry sword with a curved blade and a single cutting edge
The officer drew his sabre and charged.

a person who writes screenplays
The screenwriter worked tirelessly on the script for the new film.

the right side of a ship or aircraft, facing forward
The captain ordered the helmsman to turn the ship to starboard.

a person who parks cars; a personal attendant
The hotel offers a valet service for its guests.

a person or thing whose unpredictable nature makes them a risk or an exciting prospect
The new player is a wildcard, capable of surprising everyone.

the degree to which something is affordable
The affordability of housing is a major concern in the city.
